pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with soft-to-moderate edge gradients. Patches on the flank exhibit a mix of sub-rectilinear and lobed geometries with variable spatial area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous lattice of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. Pathway thickness remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous dark silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge showing low-amplitude textural roughness.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Diffuse area of grey-tone textural disruption and de-pigmentation visible on the lower-to-mid flank, obscuring the primary patch pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, dark-colored protruding mass or localized growth on the anterior-ventral chest/lower neck region.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant loss of pigment and patch clarity on the ventral abdomen.
